name: Kin'youbi no Koneko
source:
After the nuclear World  War III new race of demihumans is born. They become foundation for labor jobs with the human population greatly diminished.
Main character picks up a cute demihuman girl on the street. She starts to accompany protagonist everywhere - at school, at part-time jobs and during leisure time. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
核战引发的第三次世界大战结束后，一个新的亚人种族诞生。人类人口大幅减少，亚人因而成为劳动力的基础。
主人公在街上捡到一名可爱的亚人少女。此后，无论上学、兼职还是休闲，她都始终陪伴在主人公身边。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
